summary: Element getter: a2 is a __usercall base pointer (passed in ESI) to a structure whose 32-bit element array begins at offset +20; a1 (passed in EAX) is the element index. Returns the dword at base + 4*a1 + 20.

operations.description: Compute the element address as a2 + 4*a1 + 20, i.e. index a1 into a 4-byte-element array located at offset 20 of the object a2 points to.
Load and return the dword at the computed address (element a1 of the array at a2+20).

unresolved: The object type a2 references and the semantic meaning of the indexed 32-bit elements are unknown from this function alone.
No bounds check on a1 exists, so out-of-range indexes read past the array.
